hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Bsbasil baby clothing — fabrics, sizing, safety, shipping, and more.

faqs.question: What is Bsbasil?
faqs.answer: Bsbasil is an Indian baby clothing brand specialising in soft, safe, and stylish clothing for newborns and toddlers aged 0–3 years. Every piece is designed with a parent's peace of mind at the centre — gentle on delicate skin, easy to put on, and made to last through all the adventures of early childhood.

faqs.question: Where is Bsbasil based?
faqs.answer: Bsbasil is based in India. We ship across the country and our products are crafted keeping Indian climate conditions and traditional aesthetics in mind — from breathable cottons for warm summers to cosy knits for cooler months.

faqs.question: What age group does Bsbasil cater to?
faqs.answer: Our entire range is designed for babies and toddlers aged 0 to 3 years. We offer sizes from newborn (0–3 months) all the way up to 2–3 years, so you can find the perfect fit at every stage of your little one's growth.

faqs.question: Where can I buy Bsbasil products?
faqs.answer: You can browse and shop our full collection directly on our website at bsbasil.com. You can also reach us on WhatsApp at +91 7700905962 to place an order or ask any questions before purchasing.

faqs.question: What fabrics does Bsbasil use?
faqs.answer: We use a carefully selected range of baby-safe fabrics including 100% pure cotton, soft muslin, breathable jersey knit, and gentle blended fabrics. All materials are chosen for their softness, breathability, and durability — ideal for a baby's sensitive skin.

faqs.question: Are Bsbasil clothes safe for newborns?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. Safety is our top priority. All our fabrics are free from harmful dyes and chemicals. Our garments are designed with flat seams and tagless labels to prevent irritation, and all fastenings are securely stitched to meet infant safety standards.

faqs.question: Are the dyes used in Bsbasil clothing safe for babies?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use only non-toxic, baby-safe dyes across our range. The vibrant colours you see in our collection are achieved without compromising on safety — no harsh chemicals, no skin irritants.

faqs.question: How should I wash Bsbasil clothing?
faqs.answer: We recommend machine washing on a gentle cycle with cold or lukewarm water using a mild, baby-safe detergent. Avoid bleach and fabric softeners. Tumble dry on low or air dry in shade to preserve the softness and colour of the fabric.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right size for my baby?
faqs.answer: Our sizes are based on age and approximate weight. As a general guide: Newborn (up to 3.5 kg), 0–3 months (3.5–6 kg), 3–6 months (6–8 kg), 6–12 months (8–10 kg), 1–2 years (10–12 kg), 2–3 years (12–14 kg). If your baby is between sizes, we recommend sizing up for a comfortable fit with room to grow.

faqs.question: Do Bsbasil clothes run true to size?
faqs.answer: Our clothing is designed to fit true to age-based sizing with a comfortable, non-restrictive fit. Babies grow quickly, so many parents prefer to size up slightly. If you are unsure, feel free to contact us on WhatsApp at +91 7700905962 and we will help you pick the right size.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: You can shop directly on our website at bsbasil.com. Simply browse the catalog, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can also reach us on WhatsApp at +91 7700905962 to place an order directly.

faqs.question: Does Bsbasil ship across India?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to all major cities and towns across India. Delivery timelines vary by location but typically range from 3–7 business days. You will receive a tracking update once your order is dispatched.

faqs.question: What payment methods does Bsbasil accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major payment methods including credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, and popular wallets. All transactions are processed securely.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange a product?
faqs.answer: We want you to be completely happy with your purchase. If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery on WhatsApp at +91 7700905962 or email us at packology.ent@gmail.com and we will make it right.

faqs.question: What types of baby clothing does Bsbasil offer?
faqs.answer: We make five kinds of baby clothes: rompers, sets, sleepwear, winter wear, and accessories. Every piece is for ages 0–3.

faqs.question: What can I shop besides rompers?
faqs.answer: Besides rompers, the shop has sets, sleepwear, winter wear, and accessories. Open Shop and filter by that kind.

faqs.question: Can I give Bsbasil clothes as a gift?
faqs.answer: Yes. A romper or a set is an easy gift for a baby shower, a naming ceremony, or a birthday. Pick the age on the product page so the size is right.

faqs.question: Are Bsbasil products suitable as baby shower gifts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rompers, sets, sleepwear, winter wear, and accessories are all easy to give. Choose the age on the product page so the size matches the baby.
